preToolUse.powershell: $t = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $shell = $t -match '"toolName"\s*:\s*"(bash|powershell)"'; if ($shell -and $t -match 'git\s+push\b.*\s(--force|-f)\b') { '{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"A force push is refused: ask the user."}' } elseif ($shell -and $t -match 'git\s+push\b') { '{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"A push needs the user."}' } elseif ($t -match '(?i)(\.env|\.pem|\.pfx|\.p12|\.key|id_rsa|id_ed25519|\.tfstate)\b') { '{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"A secret file: ask the user for what you need from it."}' }
preToolUse.bash: t=$(cat); shell=0; printf '%s' "$t" | grep -Eq '"toolName" *: *"(bash|powershell)"' && shell=1; if [ $shell = 1 ] && printf '%s' "$t" | grep -Eq 'git +push.* (--force|-f)([^a-zA-Z0-9_]|$)'; then echo '{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"A force push is refused: ask the user."}'; elif [ $shell = 1 ] && printf '%s' "$t" | grep -Eq 'git +push'; then echo '{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"A push needs the user."}'; elif printf '%s' "$t" | grep -Eiq '(\.env|\.pem|\.pfx|\.p12|\.key|id_rsa|id_ed25519|\.tfstate)([^a-zA-Z0-9_]|$)'; then echo '{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"A secret file: ask the user for what you need from it."}'; fi; exit 0
